title: The 8 Best Straight Router Bits 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for straight router bits 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at straight router bits 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Freud 04-100 1/8-Inch Double Flute Straight Bit
products.blurb: Key specs: 1/4-inch cutting diameter, TiCo carbide, Two-flute design.
strengths: TiCo carbide is harder and stays sharper longer than standard carbide in straight bit service
1/4-inch diameter is the most commonly needed groove width for shelf pins, small dadoes, and slots
Two-flute design provides clean cut walls and good chip clearance
Freud 04-100 is the reference recommendation for general straight bit purchases
limitations: Need to buy multiple bits or a set to cover different groove widths
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Freud 91-102 6-Piece Straight Bit Set
products.blurb: Key specs: Multiple diameters, TiCo carbide throughout, 1/4 and 1/2-inch shanks.
strengths: Set covers the most common straight bit diameters (1/4, 3/8, 1/2, 3/4, 1-inch) in one purchase
TiCo carbide on every bit in the set -- no quality downgrade in the smaller sizes
Mix of 1/4 and 1/2-inch shanks matched to the bit size for appropriate stability
The most practical first straight bit purchase for a new woodworker
limitations: Some sizes in the set may see infrequent use

products.name: Freud 12-128 1/2-Inch Straight Bit, Eclipse Grind
products.blurb: Key specs: Eclipse grind geometry, 1/2-inch diameter, 1/2-inch shank.
strengths: Eclipse grind produces a shearing action that leaves smoother groove walls than a standard grind
1/2-inch diameter and shank for maximum stability in production dado and groove cutting
TiCo Hi-Density carbide holds an edge through repeated production cuts
The professional choice for cabinet dado and groove work
limitations: Higher price than a basic straight bit
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: YONICO 14522q Router Bits Set Straight, 5 Bit
products.blurb: Key specs: Multiple sizes, Budget price, 1/4-inch shanks.
strengths: Multiple sizes in one purchase at the lowest total cost
Good starting set for learning router operations and groove cutting
Yonico carbide is acceptable for softwood and plywood in moderate use
Covers the most common groove diameters for learning joinery
limitations: Yonico carbide dulls faster in hardwood than Freud or Whiteside
Groove walls less clean than premium bits
1/4-inch shanks only -- less stable for larger diameters
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Bosch 85242MC 1/2 in. x 1-1/2 in. Carbide-Tipped Straight Router Bit
products.blurb: Key specs: 1/2-inch diameter, Micro-grain carbide, 1/4-inch shank.
strengths: Bosch micro-grain carbide provides harder edges than standard carbide formulations
1/2-inch diameter is the correct size for 1/2-inch plywood bottom grooves in drawers
Bosch quality control produces consistent carbide geometry
Widely available at home centers for easy replacement
limitations: 1/4-inch shank on a 1/2-inch diameter bit -- less stable than a 1/2-inch shank bit of the same size

products.name: CMT 81131 Contractor Straight Bit, 3/4-Inch
products.blurb: Key specs: 3/4-inch diameter, Micro-grain carbide, Anti-kickback body.
strengths: 3/4-inch diameter is the correct size for 3/4-inch plywood dado joints and shelf dadoes
Anti-kickback body reduces the catch risk at large diameters where more material is engaged
1/2-inch shank for the stability required at 3/4-inch cutting diameter
CMT micro-grain carbide maintains sharpness better than standard carbide
limitations: Large diameter requires full-size router with sufficient horsepower
Anti-kickback limits maximum feed rate slightly

products.name: Freud 76-102 Down Spiral Bit, 1/4-Inch
products.blurb: Key specs: Spiral flutes, TiCo Hi-Density carbide, Shear cut.
strengths: Spiral flutes produce a shearing cut that dramatically reduces tearout on groove walls
TiCo Hi-Density carbide for strong edge retention
The correct upgrade from standard straight bits for fine furniture and cabinetry
Clean, smooth groove walls that require less sanding than straight-flute bits
limitations: Higher price than carbide-tipped straight bits
Down-cut geometry pushes chips downward, requiring good dust extraction in deep grooves

products.name: MLCS 8375 Straight Router Bit 5-Piece Boxed Set
products.blurb: Key specs: Multiple sizes, Carbide-tipped, Various shanks.
strengths: MLCS is the best-value straight bit set brand -- better quality than Yonico at a small price premium
Good coverage of common groove diameters
MLCS bits perform well in softwood and moderate hardwood use
The step-up choice between Yonico budget and Freud premium
limitations: Lower carbide quality than Freud or Whiteside
Less consistent geometry than premium brands
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money
